messages.subject: Project Quartz — Patent Licence Agreement v1 (draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Attached is our first full draft of the Patent Licence Agreement (v1) for your review before we send to the other side. It reflects the term-sheet economics (£1.5m upfront, 6.5% royalty), exclusive in the Field in Europe, full warranty and indemnity package, and a liability cap at the greater of £5m or fees paid. The Verdant evaluation licence will be handled via a side letter rather than in the body.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
